items.title: What are the AI lab compute commitments?
items.summary: Investing.com -- OpenAI’s artificial intelligence computing commitments could translate into $614 billion of infrastructure spending through 2030, substantially below widely cited figures of $750 billion, according to Bernstein analyst Mark Moerdler, who sees limited immediate risk for major cloud providers.

items.title: Older Nvidia Chips Just Cost Oracle Its Microsoft AI Deal
items.summary: Microsoft is quietly switching off the AI servers it rented from Oracle, and Oracle insists its aging GPUs still command a premium. Which story holds up, and what does it mean for a stock already down by half?

items.title: Walton Family Gets $100 Billion Richer As Walmart Surges
items.summary: Among the world's wealthiest people, they are the only ones who never founded or ran a company, yet their fortunes are climbing while tech titans slide. What explains the Waltons' remarkable 2026 run?

items.title: 3 Cash Flow Stocks Trading Up To 47% Below Fair Value
items.summary: Bond markets just absorbed a stronger than expected US jobs report, and Treasury yields moved higher as investors braced for possible rate hikes. Higher discount rates tend to punish stocks priced on distant hopes rather than hard cash today. That shift draws attention to businesses generating solid cash inflows yet priced below estimated fair value. items.title: CoreWeave’s Bonds Now Yield More Than 16%, Days Before Earnings
items.summary: Credit markets and stock analysts are telling opposite stories about CoreWeave, and only one can be right. A single earnings report on November 10 will decide which side has misread a company that still needs tens of billions to build.

items.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Just Issued a 6-Word Warning That Could Spell Disaster for AI Stocks
items.summary: Two AI stocks lost nearly half their value in a month while Microsoft barely moved. The split has less to do with chips than with one question every data center builder now has to answer, and rising rates are forcing the issue.
